name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's fascination with motorsport began in his youth, captivated by the precision and engineering of Formula 1 cars. He pursued mechanical engineering at Seoul National University, focusing on materials science and advanced manufacturing techniques. After graduation, Park worked for a Hyundai subsidiary, honing his skills in precision machining and quality control. His dedication and innovative approach quickly earned him recognition, but his passion remained firmly rooted in motorsport. 

Driven by his dream, Park transitioned to a smaller racing team, where he relished the challenge of crafting bespoke components and troubleshooting complex mechanical issues. He believes in a holistic approach to machining, meticulously considering the interplay between design, material properties, and manufacturing processes. His attention to detail is legendary, and he often spends hours perfecting even the smallest parts. Park is known for his ability to blend traditional machining techniques with cutting-edge technologies, ensuring both reliability and performance.

Park's reputation as a meticulous and innovative machinist precedes him. He's not just about following blueprints; he seeks to understand the underlying principles and optimize designs for peak performance. He is always looking for ways to improve efficiency and output and is eager to impart his knowledge to junior team members.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave.
physical.description: A man of medium build, Park has a focused gaze and a kind smile that puts people at ease.
